newsitem.title: USA: Newmont sets higher 1997 gold target.
newsitem.headline: Newmont sets higher 1997 gold target.

text.p: Newmont Mining Corp said on Wednesday that its Newmont Gold Co subsidiary set a gold production target of 2.5 million ounces for 1997, after producing a record 2.28 million ounces in 1996.

Even though it surpassed its 1996 production goal of 2.1 million ounces, a fourth-quarter decline in gold prices and higher cash costs throughout the year held Newmont's earnings rise below its goal of 10 percent, the company said.
It expects to reduce total cash costs by 10 percent in 1997.
Newmont Mining Corp owns 91 percent of Newmont Gold Co, its sole asset.
